## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #201, exact head `c75550766100703a11f2bafa9205011c95b214fe`. Complete three-file docs/skill-check delta reviewed under C33/C34.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No in-scope vulnerability or blocking disclosure identified | - |

No private owner/name identity, private content, machine-local path or secret was identified. The operational guidance retains quoted command placeholders, requester reply-mode semantics, memory reporting and the explicit warning that role model settings are not applied automatically.

The skill-check change only raises the community route's line budget from 100 to 110 (`harness/scripts/pij-skill-check.sh:71`); no execution, path handling or refusal logic changes. SKILL.md updates its route description, not permissions.

**C34 follow-up:** clarify/remove the closing line's “until #200” parenthetical (`skills/pij/references/routes/community.md:81`). #200 prevents continuity from reopening the row; it still does not kill the process. The existing close-then-kill-pane instruction itself remains correct.

GitHub metadata and remote pull ref agree; final status is CLEAN. CI `42558804372` and Delivers `42558804597` passed at this exact SHA. No local rendering, script execution, tests, builds, credential reads or mutations ran.
